description: Fetch the first output image from a completed prompt and upload it to ComfyUI input folder. Returns the filename to use in LoadImage for a follow-up workflow (e.g. image caption / verification). Use after get_execution confirms the prompt finished with image output. Requires COMFYUI_HOST.

prompt_id.description: Prompt id from execute_workflow (run must be completed with image output)

name: prepare_image_for_workflow
